name: @starkware-libs/anystark-paymaster-proxy
description: Thin, stateless SNIP-29 paymaster sponsorship proxy: holds the upstream API key server-side and enforces a sponsorship policy. Provider-agnostic, works with any SNIP-29 upstream.
//build: Uses plain tsc rather than the sibling packages' tsup: this package ships a deployable proxy (serverless functions / a worker) alongside a library surface, so tsc compiles both roots (src + adapters) into dist/src and dist/adapters, and publishConfig points the published entry points there.
//starknet: Runtime dependency of the policy-generator bin (scripts/generate_policy.mjs), which computes sn_keccak selectors with hash.getSelectorFromName and canonicalizes felts with num.toHex64.
